question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"first."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"First"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 
• It indicates the initial step or action in a sequence, before any others. (सबसे पहले)
 
 
• **Example**:* **Rahul arrived **first**__ at the party.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
 
• **Correct passage**:

Today, I want to talk to you about a very simple matter, that is, simple conversations. When we learn to speak, __**first**__ come words, then phrases, and then scripts. You would agree that the larger the bundles of words we ______ (2) _______, the less we have to worry about combining them into sensible ______ (3) ______. Also the less we have to fret over syntax or ______ (4) ______. Do you think you choose the words? Do you pre-rehearse every time you go out? ______ (5) ______ what happens when you walk into a fast-food restaurant. My dear, how do you react in those real life situations?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Finally" **means at last or in the end. (अंततोगत्‍वा, आख़िरकार, अंत में)
 
• **"Hence" **means therefore or as a result. (अतएव, इस कारण से, फलतः)
 
• **"Then"** indicates a chronological order or sequence. (उस समय, तब)
